# Notexia (notexia.in)

> Notexia is a modern academic research, note-taking, and knowledge-sharing platform for scholars, developers, and researchers.

## Core Features
- **Smart AI Notes & Research**: Exhaustive AI paper generation, markdown rendering, and LaTeX formula support (KaTeX).
- **Public Feed & Articles**: Community-driven research papers, technical blogs, and peer-reviewed study notes.
- **Smart Revision & Copilot**: AI-assisted study checklists, flashcards, and chat copilot.
- **Community & Discussions**: Doubts resolution hub, forums, and developer projects.

## Key Index & Structure
- [Public Feed](https://notexia.in/feed): Latest research papers, articles, and public notes.
- [Research Workspace](https://notexia.in/research): AI-powered academic paper generator and editor.
- [Public Blogs](https://notexia.in/blogs): Published articles by researchers and educators.
- [Community Hub](https://notexia.in/community): Scholar profiles, rankings, and collaboration.
- [Leaderboard](https://notexia.in/leaderboard): Community contribution points and rankings.

## Technology Stack
- Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TipTap, KaTeX, MongoDB, Anthropic Claude & Google Gemini AI.
